name: Do I need a permit to widen an interior doorway in the Bay Area?

mainEntity.name: Do I need a permit to widen an interior doorway in the Bay Area?

acceptedAnswer.text: Permit requirements for interior doorway modifications in the Bay Area can vary by city and the scope of work. Minor changes, such as installing offset hinges, typically do not require a permit. However, if the modification involves altering a load-bearing wall or significantly changing the structural integrity of the home, a permit is likely required. City Dweller, LLC can help determine specific permit needs for your project in areas like Pacifica or Daly City.
acceptedAnswer.description: Permit needs for widening an interior doorway in the Bay Area depend on the scope, especially if structural changes or load-bearing walls are involved.
